-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #12 - Function talkevent8_1
function talkevent8_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.map")
	MoveCamera(366.00, 329.00, 83.34)
	RotCamera(5.59, 1.49, 23.00)

	CreateObject(0, 1478, 361.00, 325.00, 224, 0, FALSE, 1, 1)
	CreateObject(1, 1480, 365.00, 320.00, 180, 0, FALSE, 1, 19)
	CreateObject(2, 1481, 382.00, 341.00, 52, 0, FALSE, 1, 28)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayCameraNoWait("tutorial_01_12.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 12)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(talkevent8_1)
